PLAN "Postpartum On-Ramp 10-14wpp"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Rebuild strength and pelvic floor-friendly conditioning"

PHASES
  PHASE "On-Ramp" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Acclimatisation - full body":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bodyweight_squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          push_up 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Core + posterior chain":
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x20..40 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Upper focus - mobility":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          inverted_row 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Strength foundation A":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Strength foundation B":
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Mobility + light conditioning":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          kettlebell_swing 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          pallof_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Progressive load A":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          push_up 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Progressive load B":
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Conditioning - low impact":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          kettlebell_swing 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Build and test A":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          push_up 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x60..90 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Build and test B":
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x15..20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Recovery and prep for next phase":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          pallof_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15..20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m

ANNOTATION "Return-to-Run Notes":
  text "Do not start running until cleared by provider and no pelvic floor/abdominal symptoms (no bulging, urine leakage, pain, or heaviness). Begin with walk-run progression: short easy runs (1–5 minutes) interspersed with walking; progress no more than ~10–20% per week in total run time. Monitor pelvic floor fatigue, heaviness, or doming/bulging at the linea alba — stop and regress if present. Continue anti-flexion core work (plank, pallof press, hollow hold) and pelvic floor awareness. Prefer low-impact HIIT (cycling) until 3 months postpartum or until running mechanics feel normal and screening for diastasis/linea alba is satisfactory. For a 10k in autumn (~3–6+ months away), plan a gradual run-build phase starting once she tolerates 20–30 minutes continuous easy running without symptoms, maintain 2 strength sessions/week focusing on hip and core resilience, and include one run workout per week (easy or short intervals)."
